content_sections.heading: RHFL Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: The official notification gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download RHFL notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Any Graduate (necessarily preceded by SSLC (or equivalent) and HSC/Diploma) with minimum 50% marks from a UGC recognized University Experience: Freshers / experienced; preference for relevant prior experience in Home Loan/Operations/Retail Credit etc. Age limit: Maximum 23 years (as on 1 November 2026) Age relaxation: Maximum relaxation 5 years, considered with commensurate relevant experience Other conditions: Fluency in English besides applicable local language (read, write and speak) is preferred Working knowledge of Hindi is an added advantage Early joining will be preferred Proficiency in MS-Word is listed as a key competency Desirable: Relevant prior experience in Home Loan / Operations / Retail Credit etc.

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for RHFL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: External candidates with pending disciplinary action at the time of applying External candidates punished under disciplinary proceedings in the last 5 years

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Pay is based on current CTC plus attractive incentives; no amount is printed. The company may offer suitable cadre/emoluments at its discretion depending on profile, past experience and performance in the selection process. Probation: 1 year No transfer requests considered for 3 years Appointments subject to satisfactory reference / background verification

content_sections.text: Shortlisting as per prescribed criteria and management discretion, depending on number of applications received Further selection process for shortlisted candidates; date, venue and mode communicated individually Shortlisting as per prescribed criteria and management discretion Shortlisted candidates are called for further selection process; date, venue and mode communicated individually

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RHFL Recruitment 2026 by Email
content_sections.text: Apply only in the enclosed bio-data format, with NOC if applicable and a detailed CV. Applications may be sent by email, post or courier. Email: send the scanned bio-data format and detailed CV to [email protected] . Post/courier: send in a sealed envelope superscribed 'Application for RECRUITMENT FOR CLERICAL CADRE FOR NORTH REGIONS – Nov 2026' to The GM (HR), Repco Home Finance Limited, Chennai. Application must reach by 5 pm on 26-11-2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for RHFL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for RHFL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 26 November 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for RHFL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 23 years (as on 1 November 2026). Relaxation: Maximum relaxation 5 years, considered with commensurate relevant experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Based on current CTC plus attractive incentives.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Any Graduate (necessarily preceded by SSLC (or equivalent) and HSC/Diploma) with minimum 50% marks from a UGC recognized University.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Fluency in English besides applicable local language (read, write and speak) is preferred. Working knowledge of Hindi is an added advantage. Early joining will be preferred. Proficiency in MS-Word is listed as a key competency.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: External candidates with pending disciplinary action at the time of applying. External candidates punished under disciplinary proceedings in the last 5 years.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting as per prescribed criteria and management discretion, depending on number of applications received. Further selection process for shortlisted candidates; date, venue and mode communicated individually. Shortlisting as per prescribed criteria and management discretion. Shortlisted candidates are called for further selection process; date, venue and mode communicated individually.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Probation: 1 year. No transfer requests considered for 3 years. Appointments subject to satisfactory reference / background verification.

faq.answer: North Branches.
